set.body:
Scope:
Implement the sojourn-slurm translation seam and expose portable and explicitly provider-specific submission lanes without weakening the generic Site API.

Acceptance criteria:
- SlurmRequestCompiler maps ExecutionRequirements plus PlacementClass to ResourceRequest plus SiteIntent or a typed SlurmPlanningFailure.
- SingleProcess(n) lowers to one registered process with cpusPerTask=n; it does not fabricate multiple ranks or executions.
- Memory, walltime, scratch, and accelerators either lower with documented semantics or fail explicitly when the configured site cannot represent them.
- Named placement classes resolve through site configuration to typed account/partition/QoS/module/container/constraint intent.
- Portable TaskRunner remains backend-neutral.
- Advanced users can opt into a typed SlurmTaskRunner or equivalent adapter-specific surface for reviewed SiteIntent overrides; no Map[String,String] escape hatch enters core.
- Requested portable requirements and effective Slurm resolution are retained for TaskRecord projection.
- Batch tests cover exact lowering, profile defaults/caps, unsupported requirements, changed-plan conflicts, CLI/SSH parity, and successful attachment to existing managed attempts.
set.title: SOJ.R3: Compile portable requirements into typed Slurm plans
